$comment: Alpina fleet service registry, canonical home. FLEET.md is generated prose about this file, not a second source. A row's `status` starts with 'live' only when the host actually answers: helpers filter on that prefix. 'retiring' marks a host that still answers but is scheduled to go away, so a consumer can stop linking to it without it disappearing from the inventory. Audited against reality 2026-09-05; upwork-crm.domain stays on alpina.solutions until decision D1 in the 2026-09-02 fleet audit spec settles the cutover.
